parameters.query:
SET search_path TO inventario;

-- Detalle de ventas del día
SELECT 
    'detalle'                               AS tipo,
    v.id::TEXT                              AS venta_id,
    cl.nombre                               AS cliente,
    p.nombre                                AS producto,
    p.codigo,
    dv.cantidad,
    dv.precio_unitario,
    dv.cantidad * dv.precio_unitario        AS subtotal,
    v.total,
    v.fecha::DATE                           AS fecha
FROM ventas v
JOIN clientes cl      ON cl.id = v.cliente_id
JOIN detalle_venta dv ON dv.venta_id = v.id
JOIN productos p      ON p.id = dv.producto_id
WHERE v.fecha::DATE = CURRENT_DATE

UNION ALL

-- Resumen general del día
SELECT 
    'resumen'                               AS tipo,
    COUNT(DISTINCT v.id)::TEXT              AS venta_id,
    SUM(dv.cantidad)::TEXT                  AS cliente,
    COALESCE(SUM(v.total),0)::TEXT         AS producto,
    COUNT(dv.id)::TEXT                      AS codigo,
    0                                       AS cantidad,
    ROUND(AVG(v.total),2)                  AS precio_unitario,
    COALESCE(SUM(v.total),0)               AS subtotal,
    COALESCE(SUM(v.total),0)               AS total,
    CURRENT_DATE                            AS fecha
FROM ventas v
JOIN detalle_venta dv ON dv.venta_id = v.id
WHERE v.fecha::DATE = CURRENT_DATE;
